sp_rg_cleric: Ravenna, dark cleric to the Rear Guard. This is the north gate of Silverpine; Tirisfal is at your back. The Light never answered us. The Dark has, at least, though it prefers its prayers in a lower key. I keep the rites for this garrison and for a few who are not in it.
sp_rg_apothecary: Pell, apothecary, Forsaken Rear Guard. Do not touch the cauldron. Do not breathe the cauldron. Look at it from a distance, if you must. The Society sent me to the border because the wind here blows south, away from anyone they would miss.
sp_rg_captain: Captain Hollin Vesk, Forsaken Rear Guard. This gate is where Tirisfal ends and Silverpine starts, and the Trunk Road runs south from it through the whole forest. We hold the gate so the Sepulcher can pretend the north is quiet. It is not quiet.
sp_farthing_widow: Marta. This is Olsen's Farthing, the north-west farms, and that is my house. My husband walks past the window every night. He does not knock. I leave the lamp on anyway, and I would be grateful if you did not ask me what I am hoping for.
sp_farthing_gaffer: Gaffer Olsen. The Farthing is mine - forty years I kept this farm, and three more since I died. The hounds do not seem to mind either way. They have gone wrong, though, the hounds, and the hands with them. You can see them from the top gate.
sp_north_scout: Scout, Rear Guard. I work the Trunk Road south of the gate - the Farthing is off to the west of here and the Dead Field to the east. Worgs run these woods some nights. Keep to the road after dark, and if you see tracks leaving it, tell me where.
sp_df_huntress: Verrel, huntress. That is the Dead Field in front of you, east of the Trunk Road, and I have the fence line. The crows do not die. They only look at you, as if you were the strange one. There is a thing out in the deep furrows that they answer to.
sp_df_farmhand: Tobb. I was a hand on this field when it was called something else. I sleep in the barn, on the west edge of it. The scarecrows do not climb the ladder, so far. They work the rows at night the way we used to, and I would like to know who is paying them.
sp_north_cemetery_keeper: Oswin, keeper of Raven Hill Cemetery. You are on the hill, west of the Trunk Road; the Sepulcher is south, down the lane. The dead here do not always stay that way. I have buried the same corpse three times this month, and he is getting better at it.
sp_rh_acolyte: Dessa, acolyte. I tend the lower rows of Raven Hill. The moss on these stones is not growing. It is feeding. I would stay on the path if I were you, and I would not lean on anything while we talk.
sp_sd_webhunter: Corvane, webhunter. This is the Skittering Dark, the east edge of the forest, and the name is fair. Keep your eyes up. The thing that gets you is never on the ground. The road runs on east from here to a cave I have not been into.
sp_sep_gatewarden: Ilsa, gatewarden. The iron door behind me is the Sepulcher - the keep, the garrison, and a bed if you are owed one. It is open to the dead. For everyone else it is a door with a very bad temper. Raven Hill is north of here and Malden's Orchard south.
sp_north_pools_warden: Yaelis, warden of the Shadowspring Pools. They are just south-east of where we are standing, on the east side of the forest. The spring used to run sweet. Now it runs black, and the things that drink from it run hungry.
sp_orchard_warden: Malwick, orchard-warden. This is Malden's Orchard, the south-west corner of the north woods. Malden grew the sweetest apples in Lordaeron. Now the orchard grows what it likes, and what it likes gets up and walks about between the rows.
